properties.name: MathE Test Recommendation
properties.description: Recommends a set of MathE multiple-choice questions tailored to a student's level on a given topic.

properties.name: Test Recommendation
properties.description: Selects MathE multiple-choice questions (statement, answer options, index of the correct option), returned as JSON text, suited to a student's proficiency level on a MathE topic. Returns the questions only, without any explanation of the answers.

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: Student proficiency from 0.0 (beginner) to 1.0 (expert), e.g. a good student is about 0.75.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: MathE topic name, one of: Real Functions of a Single Variable, Differentiation, Integration, Fundamental Mathematics, Complex Numbers, Optimization, Statistics, Real Functions of Several Variables, Differential Equations, Probability, Linear Algebra, Graph Theory, Analytic Geometry, Numerical Methods, Discrete Mathematics.

outputs.name: questions
outputs.description: JSON-serialized list of multiple-choice questions, each {"statement": string, "options": [string], "answer": integer (zero-based index of the correct option)}. A string rather than an array because ap-management's magic operator only accepts string inputs.
